milestones.note: Not published on 24 September 2026. Applications open from the November before. In 2026 the main deadline was 22 July at 14:00; medicine closed on 16 March for IB applicants. At the University of Malta the IB counts as a local qualification: choose "Local Qualifications" when you apply.
